rendered: The anode-free full cell (pre-sodiated pyrite cathode) reaches ∼400 Wh/kg[1], while the paper gives the theoretical maximum for LiCoO2/graphite cells as 387 Wh/kg[2]. The full cell therefore exceeds that maximum by about 13[3] Wh/kg (approximate, since the cell figure is itself given as an approximate value). The state-of-the-art sodium-ion full cells the paper cites reach only ∼200 Wh/kg[4] with respect to active mass.
